questions.question: Round 10's divergence check fired, and every one of rounds 7 to 10 found a call family or axis the previous fix hadn't enumerated. I went through every `_choke` site (25 in the async core, plus 4 in the sync-only `backend.py`). Six separate helpers each re-implement the question "what is at this key": `_probe`, `_stat_open`, `_folder_is_wrong_type`, `_target_is_wrong_type`, `_holds_nothing` and `_target_stat`. Each one has its own namespace and stat-shape rules, and that is where the drift comes from. How should the re-plan restructure this?

options.label: One classifier, one oracle (Recommended)
options.description: Replace the six helpers with one `_state(op, key)`. It is namespace-aware and answers absent / file / folder / under-a-file / unknown, and a flat namespace is never 'under a file': a file at a prefix doesn't rule out keys below it. Each family maps (refusal, state) to its answer through one table. One product generates family × driver × 7 key states × refusal shape × 5 stat behaviours × route axes, with the oracle per spec clause. The 4 behaviour findings get fixed by construction. Bigger diff (it replaces code from rounds 7 to 9), but the axis set becomes shared instead of being re-derived per family.

options.label: Extend in place
options.description: Keep the helpers. Add the missing axes to the existing products (flat shadowing key, a real folder under a refusal, stat raising untyped/denied, exists/is_file/is_folder, folder_stats push-down) and fix each finding locally. Smaller diff, but the next family or axis is still re-derived per helper, which is the pattern the last four rounds show.

options.label: Shrink the kernel's job
options.description: Reverse decision 9. A `list_page` obligation: refuse a non-folder only as NotFound/InvalidPath. A `stat` obligation: answer None or NotFound under a file. Delete `_holds_nothing` and the push-down typing. This gives the fewest probes and the smallest code, but typing moves back into drivers, against decision 3's D1 reasoning.

questions.question: Finding 4 (`stat` of a key under a file raising untyped or PermissionDenied): what should `exists`/`is_file`/`is_folder`, `get_file_info` and the determinant stats (rename destination, temp-and-rename target) answer?

options.label: Kernel types it (Recommended)
options.description: On the error path only, on a hierarchical namespace: fail-open stats of the ancestors. A file above means the key is absent, so False / NotFound / a miss. Otherwise the refusal propagates, so a real denial stays visible. No cost when stat answers normally.

options.label: Driver obligation
options.description: State that `stat` answers None or raises NotFound for a key under a file. The kernel propagates anything else as is. This is one more obligation for each driver to honour.

questions.question: Finding 5 (double race on a non-replacing rename with overwrite: the intruding file vanishes before the displacing rename, so `move` answers NotFound(dst) with the source intact). Fix it here or file it?

options.label: Fix here (Recommended)
options.description: A NotFound from the displacing rename means the intruder is gone, so retry the plain `rename(replace=False)` once. It's a behaviour change pinned by a test I'll watch fail first. Small and local.

options.label: File a backlog item
options.description: Leave it out of this PR. It's a double race, only on non-replacing wires, and nothing is lost. A new item records it.

questions.question: The product came to 60,996 cells after reachability pruning, over the 40k bound I set in the plan. At that size the run took more than 600 s and crashed 12 xdist workers. The fake itself is cheap (0.7 MiB over 3,000 cells), so the cost is pytest's per-item overhead. How should the product be shaped?

options.label: One item per family (Recommended)
options.description: Each family becomes one pytest test per runtime, and that test loops over all of its cells and asserts on the full list of failing cell ids. Every cell is still run and checked against the oracle, and the cell counts come from the generators. The cost is per-cell granularity in pytest's own output: a failure shows up as a list of ids, not as separate red items.

options.label: Prune to under 40k
options.description: Keep one parametrized item per cell, and cut axes to get under the bound, for example the stat axis on non-rename transfers and the injected shapes reduced to one representative per probe-set class. Granularity stays the same, but some crossings stop being asked, which is the held-fixed-axis pattern that rounds 7 to 10 kept finding.

options.label: Full product, own lane
options.description: Keep all 60,996 parametrized items, mark them so `hatch run fast` and the default suite skip them, and run them in a dedicated CI job and on demand. Nothing is lost, but the local gate no longer runs the enumeration, and that lane needs its own CI wiring.

questions.question: The closing round over 936f7f0 is not clean: 7 findings. There is 1 high Bug, a regression: on a flat driver with an absent container, `exists` and `is_folder` raise NotFound instead of answering False. That is `_state`'s flat listing probe treating NotFound/InvalidPath as unknown, reproduced in both runtimes. The rest are 2 Test (the product never refuses that flat probe; an empty cell list would pass), 2 Spec (BE-030 Conformance overclaims the shared axis set for gates and construction; a NotFound stat is classified two ways) and 2 Consistency (the dossier's determinant derivation; the trace's choke-site count is 30, not 25). Neither the divergence check nor the repeat-site check fired. Findings per round: 10, then 11 (high, silent wrong value), then 7 (one high, loud error; the rest text and tests). The measuring member found everything else it ran correct, and found hot-path costs identical to base. CI is green. How should I proceed?

options.label: Fix all, one more round (Recommended)
options.description: Merge latest master first. The bug fix: a NotFound/InvalidPath from the flat folder probe answers ABSENT, pinned by a failing-first flat absent-container test. Add a flat list_page refusal axis to the probe and get_file_info families, add an absent-container state, assert every family yields cells, then fix the four text findings. Gate, push, then a closing round of unprimed + whole-file + measuring members. If that round is not clean either, I hand over.

options.label: Fix all, then hand over
options.description: Merge master, fix all 7 and push with CI green, and stop without another closing round. You or a fresh session runs the close later. Cheaper now, but the fix pass stays unreviewed, so /ship's stop rule is not met.

options.label: Stop here, hand over
options.description: Leave the 7 findings open on the PR, unfixed, and write the handoff with today's re-plan, measurements and open threads for a new session. Nothing more is pushed in this session.
